[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Rhoda was born in 1832. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-835|Robert Glasgow]]. She passed away in 1868.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-835]] is assessed at 73% (probable). The held family account identifies Rhoda Montgomery (Glasgow) Fulton as Robert Barclay Glasgow’s child, generally with Phebe McFall. Rhoda’s stated 1832 birth conflicts with memorial 1823, when Robert was18; this is a real identity/date issue requiring reconciliation.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the child’s earliest household and the cited Faris page or original gravestone parent inscription.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2222 Faris, David, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore, MD, Gateway Press, Inc., 1990), p.88]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
